description: Source code for OSDP secure channel management, including cryptographic computations, session key setup, cryptogram verification, and data encryption/decryption functions.

methods.name: osdp_memzero
methods.description: Zeroes out a memory region using volatile pointer to prevent compiler optimization.

methods.name: osdp_compute_scbk
methods.description: Computes the secure channel base key (scbk) from the device's client UID and master key.

methods.name: osdp_compute_session_keys
methods.description: Initializes session encryption and MAC keys based on device mode and flags.

methods.name: osdp_compute_cp_cryptogram
methods.description: Computes the cryptogram for the control panel using device and random data.

methods.name: osdp_ct_compare
methods.description: Constant-time comparison of two memory regions.

methods.name: osdp_verify_cp_cryptogram
methods.description: Verifies the control panel cryptogram against computed value.

methods.name: osdp_compute_pd_cryptogram
methods.description: Computes the cryptogram for the peripheral device.

methods.name: osdp_compute_rmac_i
methods.description: Computes the receive MAC for secure messaging.

methods.name: osdp_decrypt_data
methods.description: Decrypts data encrypted with AES-ECB, verifying EOM marker.

methods.name: osdp_encrypt_data
methods.description: Encrypts data with AES, appending EOM marker and padding.

methods.name: osdp_compute_mac
methods.description: Computes MAC over data using AES-CBC and ECB modes.

methods.name: osdp_sc_setup
methods.description: Initializes the secure channel, generating or preserving keys and device UID.
